chosen_line.card: All Streams Flow to the Sea

q1_what_did_you_play: I played All Streams Flow to the Sea on Sludge Spinner, then Water's Edge on Sludge Spinner, using both energy. This deals 9 damage then 6 damage, for 15 total, and applies Hydro with each card as printed.
q2_other_line_considered: I seriously considered playing Gyorin Formation instead, using both energy for 10 Block and 6 Block at the start of next turn, because the enemy telegraphs an 8 attack and I have no Block.
q3_what_it_gave_up: The chosen line gave up 10 Block this turn and 6 Block next turn, and it leaves me to take the full 8 damage, ending the turn at 40 HP instead of 48 HP with Gyorin. It also leaves Sludge Spinner at 19 HP rather than 34 HP, which is the trade.
q4_different_intent: Yes. If the enemy intent had been a much larger attack, I would have been more likely to play Gyorin Formation for the 10 Block and next-turn 6 Block. If the intent had been a weak attack or defense, the damage line would have remained attractive.
